## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: VXX (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -6.03%) RECOVERY showing rising near-term fear while HYG (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.40%) ABOVE TREND but HYG/LQD flagged CREDIT STRESS ↑ — mixed risk signals alongside sector tilt (XLK (1W: -3.07% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND vs XLE (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD shows CREDIT STRESS ↑ with HYG (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.40%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.18% | 1M: -1.14%) RECOVERY. Fear creeping higher: VXX (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -6.03%) RECOVERY and Stocks vs Bonds ratio falling with SPY (1W: -0.95% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: -0.10% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-cautious: Dollar flat (Level: 28.39 | 1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.32% → flat | NEUTRAL) and yield curve modestly flatter (Yield Curve Level: 1.0235 | 1W: -0.26% → flat | BELOW TREND). Liquidity mixed with HYG ABOVE TREND and LQD RECOVERY, leaving conditions neither clearly easing nor tightening.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing breadth support though XLF (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +4.04%) in CORRECTION; Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -3.07% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND — style: rotation toward Value/Cyclicals over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
China strength vs broader EM: FXI (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +4.13%) ABOVE TREND while EEM (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -7.29%) BELOW TREND. US in mild pullback: SPY (1W: -0.95% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION with select domestic cyclicals outperforming.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed speculative tone: IBIT (1W: +4.74% | 1M: +1.46%) ABOVE TREND and ETHA (1W: +7.18% | 1M: +9.64%) ABOVE TREND, but ARKK (1W: -4.21% | 1M: -4.51%) BELOW TREND and Speculation Index (1W: -4.51% | 1M: -5.95%) BELOW TREND — risk-on pockets but overall caution.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity squeeze: UGA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +20.44%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +13.41%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +6.55% | 1M: +9.87%) ABOVE TREND; copper CPER (1W: +1.27% | 1M: -0.57%) RECOVERY — inflation proxies firming.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy strength intact: XLE (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND while gas remains weak: UNG (1W: -0.77% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Energy leadership with XLE ABOVE TREND and broad commodity strength. DIVERGENCE: Tech/semis show coordinated weakness — XLK (1W: -3.07% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND, QQQ (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -3.55%) BELOW TREND and SOXX (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -12.60%) BELOW TREND — a sectoral flashpoint to monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to Energy/Commodity-linked ETFs and Financials as rotation candidates, and reduce exposure to headline Tech momentum ETFs given XLK/QQQ/SOXX weakness. Monitor credit (HYG/LQD) and VXX for risk regime shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND; Financials via sector breadth and XLF (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +4.04%) CORRECTION if confirmation arrives. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -3.07% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND; SOXX (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -12.60%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: UGA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +20.44%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +13.41%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -0.77% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -15.89%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 22.12 (VXX (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -6.03%) RECOVERY) for volatility re-acceleration, HYG/LQD ratio level (Credit Spread 0.7436 | 1W: +0.06% | 1M: +1.49%) ABOVE TREND for credit stress, XLK/XLF rotation measure (Tech vs Financials Level: 3.1354 | 1W: -4.07% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND as the style pivot, IBIT (1W: +4.74% | 1M: +1.46%) ABOVE TREND as a speculative risk barometer.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive with energy and select cyclicals showing strength. Key risk: coordinated Tech/semis weakness (XLK/QQQ/SOXX BELOW TREND) vs rising commodity/credit stress signals to monitor.
